final: WITH product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.production_type_code, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id), type_stats AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(ps.avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(ps.item_count) AS avg_item_count, AVG(CAST(ps.item_count AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items), 0)) AS avg_item_share FROM Product_Categories pc JOIN Products p ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code JOIN product_stats ps ON ps.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY pc.product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS average_product_quantity, AVG(avg_item_count) AS average_order_items, AVG(avg_item_share) AS average_share_of_order_items FROM type_stats
